study type: multicentre combined retrospective and prospective cohort study
outcome: infections (endometritis, cervicitis, vaginal cuff infections, peritonitis, pelvic abscess, adnexa utery, parametritis, salpingitis, sepsis)
cohort: All women who underwent induced abortion in Eastern and Southern Ukrainian-Russian military conflict regions between 2022 and 2024 were included in the study.
finding: This study found a high rate of complications (74.9%) related to induced abortion in the Ukrainian-Russian military conflict regions, with infections being the most common and several demographic, procedural, and healthcare-related factors identified as risks.
country: Ukraine (Eastern and Southern Ukrainian-Russian military conflict regions)
gest_age: Increased gestational age was identified as a risk factor for complications related to induced abortion.
